# Old Cairn, the Ancient of the Quarries

*A golem as tall as a house has risen out of the face of the First Cut, where the stone of the first keep was quarried. Its fists and its thrown rock you can see coming; when the cut cracks, run. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*
